process_formulas.velocity_proxy: u* = [a_q log(1 + Q_songpu) + a_h log(1 + Q_huangdu)] / [1 + a_d log(1 + H_songpu)]
process_formulas.bed_shear_proxy: tau* = a_tau u*^2 + a_w log(1 + wind_speed) + a_hs log(1 + |dH_songpu/dt|)
process_formulas.runoff_source: R_runoff = k_r [log(1 + runoff_sediment_pulse) + 0.35 log(1 + precipitation_3d) + 0.25 log(1 + Q_huangdu)]
process_formulas.erosion_source: R_erosion = k_e softplus(tau* - tau_ce) (1 + 0.5 reverse + 0.25 rise)
process_formulas.bloom_source: R_bloom = k_b f_T(T) f_I(light) min(f_N(N), f_P(P)) f_v(u*)
process_formulas.krone_deposition_sink: S_dep = k_d A_sed sigmoid(4 (tau_cd - tau*) / w_v) (1 + beta_floc) (1 + 0.25 log(1 + settling_index))
process_formulas.flushing_sink: S_flush = k_f A_sed u* log(1 + flushing_potential)
process_formulas.purification_sink: S_pur = k_p A_sed f_DO(DO) log(1 + self_purification_index)
process_formulas.physics_balance: log(1 + T_{t+1}) = clamp(log(1 + T_t) + R_runoff + R_erosion + R_tide + R_bloom - S_dep - S_flush - S_pur, 0)

clearness_proxy_note: Final clearness proxy is derived from fused turbidity prediction using the same monotonic transform as the dataset target.
